## Per-claim detail

### Claim 1 — CLI parity: `phi session launch`, `phi session list`, `phi session tail`, `phi session terminate` all extant; `e2e_first_session.rs` exercises full CLI surface end-to-end
**Verdict:** PARTIAL
**Evidence:**

CLI subcommand enum at `cli/src/commands/session.rs:46–117` declares 5 variants:
- `Launch` (line 55) — POSTs `/api/v0/orgs/:org/projects/:proj/sessions`, subscribes to SSE tail by default (CH-17 ADR-0055), `--detach` / `--no-tail` to skip.
- `Show` (line 79) — GETs `/api/v0/sessions/:id`.
- `Terminate` (line 86) — POSTs `/api/v0/sessions/:id/terminate`.
- `List` (line 96) — GETs sessions in a project, `--active-only` filter.
- `Preview` (line 107) — POSTs `/api/v0/sessions/preview` to dry-run the Permission Check.

**There is NO separate `Tail` subcommand.** The live SSE tail is integrated into `Launch` per CH-17 ADR-0055 (see module docstring at `session.rs:1–17`):
> "phi session launch — POST... the launch receipt then SUBSCRIBES to the live SSE tail at `GET /api/v0/sessions/:id/events`."

`grep -nE "Tail\b|fn tail|tail_impl"` on `session.rs` returns 0 hits for a separate Tail subcommand body.

The orchestrator's audit-prompt claim names `phi session tail` as a distinct subcommand. The actually-shipping CLI surface folds tail into launch (SSE consumer at `session.rs:258 consume_sse_tail`). This is a CLAIM-vs-CODE language mismatch — the tail FUNCTIONALITY is shipped end-to-end; the SUBCOMMAND NAME is not. A strict reading FAILs this claim; the spirit is satisfied (`session live_tail_test.rs:1–24` documents launch-then-tail rendering). I am calling this **PARTIAL** to record both halves of the truth.

E2E coverage at `cli/tests/e2e_first_session.rs`:
- The file exercises `phi bootstrap claim`, `phi org create`, `phi agent create`, `phi project create`, `phi session launch --no-tail`, `phi session show` (Step 6, lines 480–510).
- **NOT exercised**: `phi session list`, `phi session terminate`, `phi session preview`, separate session-tail flow (the live-tail flow has its own dedicated test at `cli/tests/session_live_tail_test.rs:1–24` per CH-17, not e2e_first_session).

So "exercises the full CLI surface end-to-end" is **not strictly true**: e2e_first_session covers the happy path (bootstrap → launch → show) but not terminate / list. The orchestrator's audit-prompt language overstates what was shipped.

**Suggested remediation**: at orchestrator gate-4 / cycle re-audit, decide whether to (a) accept the current coverage as "first-session happy path" (the original P-NEW-TESTS.2 wording — "first-session-launch journey") or (b) re-spawn implementer to add list/terminate/preview steps. (a) aligns with plan §7 P-NEW-TESTS.2 deliverable literal wording.
